title: ShankThicknessFunctionSample
description: A real sample of the deterministic thickness function t(u) = baseThicknessMm * taper_ratio(u, thicknessTaper), for u in [0, 1). Documents backend/jewelmind/geometry/shank/builder.py::_section_wire()'s thickness term (base thickness there is base_outer_r - inner_r) and the thicknessSamplesMm.headMm/bottomMm fields on generated component metadata. See docs/bible/19-shank/547-thickness-function-model.md.

u.description: Longitudinal parameter; 0/1 is the head, 0.5 is the bottom.

thicknessMm.description: baseMm * taper_ratio(u, {mode, bottomRatio}) — always exactly baseMm at u=0/u=1 regardless of mode.
